auth.instructions: Open the dashboard; user menu > My Profile > Edit Profile modal > API Auth Token > Copy. If no token exists, create one intentionally in this modal. Regenerating invalidates your other clients. The CLI never generates or regenerates a token. The selected native account is not proof of the DSM identity.
